indicators/meta/license.zh-TW: Taiwan.md 的整理與文字以 CC BY-SA 4.0 授權；各數值的原始資料依提供機關的授權（政府資料以「政府資料開放授權條款第 1 版」為主，引用時須標示原提供機關）。
indicators/meta/license.en: Taiwan.md's compilation and text are licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Each underlying value follows its publisher's licence (for government data, mainly Taiwan's Open Government Data License v1, which requires naming the original agency).

indicators/meta/method.zh-TW: 每個數值都回到發布機構的原始頁面或統計表核對，研究原檔在 reports/research/2026-10/data-hub-r5*.md，附原文逐字。
indicators/meta/method.en: Every value was checked against the publisher's own page or statistical table; the research files with verbatim quotes are in reports/research/2026-10/data-hub-r5*.md.

indicators/indicators/population/insight.zh-TW: 2019 年底到頂之後起伏往下，比高點少了大約 39 萬人。
indicators/indicators/population/insight.en: Past its peak at the end of 2019 and drifting down since, about 390,000 below the high.

indicators/indicators/births/insight.zh-TW: 十年少了一半；2024 年到 2025 年一年就少了 2.7 萬人。
indicators/indicators/births/insight.en: Half the number of ten years ago, and 27,000 fewer than the year before.

indicators/indicators/fertility-rate/ins.zh-TW: 一位女性一生平均生不到 0.7 個孩子；人口要維持不減大約需要 2.1。
indicators/indicators/fertility-rate/ins.en: A woman has fewer than 0.7 children on average over her lifetime; holding the population steady takes about 2.1.

indicators/indicators/natural-increase/i.zh-TW: 2020 年起死亡多於出生，差距一年比一年大；2025 年死亡 20 萬人、出生 10.8 萬人。
indicators/indicators/natural-increase/i.en: Deaths have outnumbered births since 2020 and the gap keeps widening: 200,000 deaths against 108,000 births in 2025.

indicators/indicators/aged-65-share/insi.zh-TW: 2025 年 12 月底跨過 20%，台灣進入超高齡社會；14 歲以下只剩 11.2%。
indicators/indicators/aged-65-share/insi.en: It crossed 20% at the end of December 2025, making Taiwan a super-aged society; under-15s are down to 11.2%.

indicators/indicators/median-age/insight.zh-TW: 一半的人超過 45.7 歲；原住民族人口的年齡中位數是 34.9 歲，年輕將近 11 歲。
indicators/indicators/median-age/insight.en: Half the population is older than 45.7; for Indigenous peoples the median is 34.9, almost 11 years younger.

indicators/indicators/life-expectancy/in.zh-TW: 女性 84.75 歲、男性 77.93 歲；縣市之間差了七歲半，臺北市 83.98 歲、臺東縣 76.49 歲。
indicators/indicators/life-expectancy/in.en: 84.75 for women and 77.93 for men, with a seven-and-a-half-year gap between Taipei (83.98) and Taitung (76.49).

indicators/indicators/marriages/insight.zh-TW: 比前一年少 15.2%；其中 3,305 對是同性伴侶，18.5% 有一方是外籍或陸港澳配偶。
indicators/indicators/marriages/insight.en: Down 15.2% on the year; 3,305 were same-sex couples, and in 18.5% one partner was foreign or from China, Hong Kong or Macau.

indicators/indicators/same-sex-marriages.zh-TW: 亞洲第一個同婚合法化的國家；累計數是本站把戶政司每年的登記數相加，每一年都是女性伴侶比男性多。
indicators/indicators/same-sex-marriages.en: Taiwan was the first in Asia to legalise same-sex marriage. The cumulative total is our sum of the annual registrations; women couples outnumber men every year.

indicators/indicators/spouses-new-reside.zh-TW: 陸港澳配偶 39.4 萬人、外籍配偶 22.9 萬人，以女性為多；陸港澳部分計的是申請證件人數。
indicators/indicators/spouses-new-reside.en: 393,700 from China, Hong Kong and Macau and 229,000 from other countries, mostly women; the mainland figure counts permit applicants.

indicators/indicators/migrant-workers/in.zh-TW: 十年增加近五成，印尼、越南、菲律賓三國占九成一；數字是本站把勞動部資料集各國籍列相加。
indicators/indicators/migrant-workers/in.en: Up almost 50% in ten years, with Indonesia, Vietnam and the Philippines making up 91%; the total is our sum of the ministry's rows by nationality.

indicators/indicators/indigenous-populat.zh-TW: 占總人口 2.7%，法定 16 族，阿美族 23.5 萬人最多；2024 年一年多了 2.3 萬人，通報沒有說明原因。
indicators/indicators/indigenous-populat.en: 2.7% of the population across 16 recognised peoples, the Amis largest at 235,000; numbers jumped by 23,000 in 2024 for reasons the ministry has not explained.

indicators/indicators/household-size/sou.zh-TW: 行政院主計總處（家庭收支調查）
indicators/indicators/household-size/sou.en: DGBAS (Survey of Family Income and Expenditure)

indicators/indicators/household-size/ins.zh-TW: 1991 年一戶 4.16 人，現在不到 2.7 人。
indicators/indicators/household-size/ins.en: Down from 4.16 people per household in 1991 to under 2.7 today.

indicators/indicators/university-intake/.zh-TW: 大學入學生源（高三學生數）
十年少了 11 萬人；大專校院學生從 133.2 萬人降到 105.7 萬人，校數五年從 152 所減為 139 所。
indicators/indicators/university-intake/.en: 110,000 fewer in ten years; tertiary enrolment fell from 1.33 million to 1.06 million, and the number of institutions from 152 to 139 in five years.

indicators/indicators/homeownership/sour.zh-TW: 行政院主計總處（家庭收支調查）
indicators/indicators/homeownership/sour.en: DGBAS (Survey of Family Income and Expenditure)

indicators/indicators/homeownership/insi.zh-TW: 所得最低的兩成家庭是 77.17%，最高的兩成是 91.46%；租屋的家庭占 7.62%。
indicators/indicators/homeownership/insi.en: 77.17% for the poorest fifth of households and 91.46% for the richest; 7.62% of households rent.

indicators/indicators/mortgage-burden/in.zh-TW: 中位數所得的家庭買一間中位數住宅（980 萬元），每月要拿可支配所得的四成三繳房貸。
indicators/indicators/mortgage-burden/in.en: A median-income household buying a median home (NT$9.8 million) would spend 43% of disposable income on the mortgage each month.

indicators/indicators/income-gap/title.zh-TW: 家庭所得五等分位差距
indicators/indicators/income-gap/title.en: Household income gap, top vs bottom fifth

indicators/indicators/income-gap/source/.zh-TW: 行政院主計總處（家庭收支調查）
indicators/indicators/income-gap/source/.en: DGBAS (Survey of Family Income and Expenditure)

indicators/indicators/income-gap/insight.zh-TW: 最高兩成家庭的可支配所得是最低兩成的 6.17 倍；扣掉每戶人數差異後是 3.73 倍。家庭可支配所得中位數 101.8 萬元。
indicators/indicators/income-gap/insight.en: The richest fifth of households have 6.17 times the disposable income of the poorest fifth, or 3.73 times per person; the median household has NT$1.018 million.

indicators/indicators/unemployment/insig.zh-TW: 失業 40.5 萬人，就業 1,164 萬人，勞動力參與率 59.59%。
indicators/indicators/unemployment/insig.en: 405,000 unemployed and 11.64 million employed, with labour force participation at 59.59%.

indicators/indicators/median-earnings/in.zh-TW: 一半的受僱者一年領不到 54.6 萬元，平均每月約 4.55 萬；女性 51.2 萬、男性 58.5 萬。2025 年的數字 11 月底發布。
indicators/indicators/median-earnings/in.en: Half of employees earn less than NT$546,000 a year, about NT$45,500 a month; women NT$512,000, men NT$585,000. The 2025 figure is due in late November.

indicators/indicators/minimum-wage/insig.zh-TW: 時薪 196 元；勞動部已公布 2027 年起調為月薪 30,900 元、時薪 205 元，連續 11 年調升。
indicators/indicators/minimum-wage/insig.en: NT$196 an hour; the ministry has announced NT$30,900 a month and NT$205 an hour from 2027, the eleventh rise in a row.

indicators/indicators/working-hours/sour.zh-TW: 勞動部（依主計總處薪資統計）

indicators/indicators/working-hours/insi.zh-TW: 工業及服務業受僱員工，其中正常工時 160.1 小時；工業部門 175.1 小時比服務業長。
indicators/indicators/working-hours/insi.en: For employees in industry and services, 160.1 of them regular hours; industry works longer, at 175.1 hours.

indicators/indicators/nhi-coverage/insig.zh-TW: 2,396 萬人在保；2010 年起都維持在 99% 以上。
indicators/indicators/nhi-coverage/insig.en: 23.96 million people insured, above 99% every year since 2010.

indicators/indicators/doctors/insight.zh-TW: 加上中醫與牙醫是每萬人 35 人；護理人員每萬人 84.1 人。
indicators/indicators/doctors/insight.en: 35 per 10,000 including Chinese medicine practitioners and dentists; 84.1 nurses per 10,000.

indicators/indicators/cancer-deaths/insi.zh-TW: 占全部死亡的 27.5%，連續 44 年是十大死因第一名；肺癌、肝癌、結腸直腸癌連續 22 年排前三。
indicators/indicators/cancer-deaths/insi.en: 27.5% of all deaths and the leading cause for 44 years running; lung, liver and colorectal cancer have been the top three for 22 years.

indicators/indicators/gdp-growth/insight.zh-TW: 2013 年以來最高，比第二高的 2021 年多出 2 個百分點；主計總處 8 月預測 2026 年再到 11.05%。
indicators/indicators/gdp-growth/insight.en: The highest since at least 2013, two points above 2021; in August the statistics office forecast 11.05% for 2026.

indicators/indicators/gdp-nominal/insigh.zh-TW: 以新臺幣計是 28.7 兆元；十年之間以美元計多了七成以上，其中一年就多了約 1,209 億美元。
indicators/indicators/gdp-nominal/insigh.en: NT$28.7 trillion in local currency; up more than 70% in dollar terms over ten years, about US$121 billion of it in the last year alone.

indicators/indicators/gdp-per-capita/ins.zh-TW: 十年多了 16,735 美元；這是總產出除以人口，跟一般人的薪水是兩件事（見社會類的薪資中位數）。
indicators/indicators/gdp-per-capita/ins.en: Up US$16,735 in ten years. This is output divided by population, which is a different thing from what a typical worker earns (see the median wage under Society).

indicators/indicators/cpi-inflation/insi.zh-TW: 經濟成長創新高的同一年，物價漲幅回落到 1.66%。
indicators/indicators/cpi-inflation/insi.en: In the same year growth hit a record, inflation eased back to 1.66%.

indicators/indicators/exports-total/insi.zh-TW: 一年增加 34.9%，進口也同時創新高；全年出超 1,571.4 億美元，同樣是紀錄。
indicators/indicators/exports-total/insi.en: Up 34.9% in a year, with imports also at a record; the trade surplus of US$157.1 billion was a record too.

indicators/indicators/exports-us-share/t.zh-TW: 對美國出口占總出口比重

indicators/indicators/exports-us-share/c.zh-TW: 同年對中國大陸與香港
indicators/indicators/exports-us-share/c.en: China and Hong Kong, same year

indicators/indicators/exports-us-share/i.zh-TW: 美國超過中國大陸與香港，成為台灣最大的出口市場，財政部說這是 26 年來第一次。
indicators/indicators/exports-us-share/i.en: The US overtook China and Hong Kong as Taiwan's largest export market, which the Ministry of Finance says is the first time in 26 years.

indicators/indicators/fx-reserves/insigh.zh-TW: 同一則公告註明，外資持有的台灣股票、債券與新臺幣存款折合 19,272 億美元，約是外匯存底的 3.2 倍。
indicators/indicators/fx-reserves/insigh.en: The same release notes that foreign holdings of Taiwanese stocks, bonds and NT dollar deposits equal US$1.93 trillion, about 3.2 times the reserves.

indicators/indicators/twse-market-cap/in.zh-TW: 九個月多了 62 兆元；台積電一家的發行市值 64.3 兆元，約占四成一（本站以證交所兩個數字相除）。
indicators/indicators/twse-market-cap/in.en: Up NT$62 trillion in nine months. TSMC alone is worth NT$64.3 trillion, about 41% of the total (our division of two exchange figures).

indicators/indicators/taiex/insight.zh-TW: 十年漲到約 3.5 倍；2026 年 9 月底已收在 47,940 點。
indicators/indicators/taiex/insight.en: About 3.5 times its level ten years earlier; by the end of September 2026 it had closed at 47,940.

indicators/indicators/ict-exports/insigh.zh-TW: 一年增加 89.5%，其中電腦及附屬單元多了 986.5 億美元；跟電子零組件合計，占總出口七成四。
indicators/indicators/ict-exports/insigh.en: Up 89.5% in a year, with computers and peripherals alone adding US$98.7 billion; together with electronic components it makes up 74% of all exports.

indicators/indicators/ic-industry-output.zh-TW: 工研院產業科技國際策略發展所
indicators/indicators/ic-industry-output.en: ITRI Industry, Science and Technology International Strategy Center

indicators/indicators/ic-industry-output.zh-TW: 年增 22.7%，製造占約三分之二；這是工研院的估計值，今年已經上修過幾次。
indicators/indicators/ic-industry-output.en: Up 22.7%, with manufacturing about two-thirds of it. This is ITRI's estimate, revised upward several times this year.

indicators/indicators/tsmc-foundry-share.zh-TW: 台積電全球晶圓代工市占
indicators/indicators/tsmc-foundry-share.en: TSMC's share of global foundry revenue

indicators/indicators/tsmc-foundry-share.zh-TW: 分母是全球前十大晶圓代工廠的營收，不含英特爾、三星這類自己做晶片的公司自用的產能。
indicators/indicators/tsmc-foundry-share.en: Measured against the revenue of the world's top ten foundries, excluding chipmakers' in-house capacity.

indicators/indicators/rd-gdp/title.en: R&D spending as share of GDP

indicators/indicators/rd-gdp/source/agen.zh-TW: 國家科學及技術委員會

indicators/indicators/rd-gdp/insight.zh-TW: 全國研發經費首度破兆（10,493 億元），其中八成六由企業出資。
indicators/indicators/rd-gdp/insight.en: National R&D spending passed NT$1 trillion for the first time (NT$1.049 trillion), 86% of it funded by business.

indicators/indicators/internet-use/title.zh-TW: 個人上網率（12 歲以上）

indicators/indicators/internet-use/insig.zh-TW: 連續幾年卡在八成七左右之後，第一次突破九成；家戶連網率 93.4%。
indicators/indicators/internet-use/insig.en: After several years stuck around 87%, it passed 90% for the first time; 93.4% of households are connected.

indicators/indicators/mobile-payment/tit.zh-TW: 網路族行動支付使用率
indicators/indicators/mobile-payment/tit.en: Mobile payment use among internet users

indicators/indicators/mobile-payment/ins.zh-TW: 第一次過半；分母是會上網的人，不是全體人口。
indicators/indicators/mobile-payment/ins.en: Above half for the first time; the base is people who use the internet, not the whole population.

indicators/indicators/power-gas/title.en: Natural gas share of power generation

indicators/indicators/power-gas/insight.zh-TW: 燃氣已經取代燃煤成為最大電源；燃煤從 45.9% 降到 35.3%，全年總發電量 2,897 億度。
indicators/indicators/power-gas/insight.en: Gas has replaced coal as the largest source; coal fell from 45.9% to 35.3%, out of 289.7 billion kWh generated in the year.

indicators/indicators/power-renewable/in.zh-TW: 十年從 127 億度增加到 386 億度，主力從水力換成太陽光電（43.4%）與風力。
indicators/indicators/power-renewable/in.en: From 12.7 to 38.6 billion kWh in ten years, with the mainstay shifting from hydro to solar (43.4%) and wind.

indicators/indicators/power-nuclear/insi.zh-TW: 2025 年全年還有 1.1%，因為最後一座核電廠到年中才停機；全年歸零要從 2026 年算起。
indicators/indicators/power-nuclear/insi.en: Still 1.1% for 2025 because the last plant ran until mid-year; a full year at zero starts in 2026.

indicators/indicators/ghg-emissions/insi.zh-TW: 扣掉碳匯後淨排放 251.4 百萬公噸，比 2005 年基準少 6.59%；製造部門占一半。清冊每年會回頭修正。
indicators/indicators/ghg-emissions/insi.en: Net of carbon sinks, 251.4 Mt, 6.59% below the 2005 baseline; manufacturing is half of the total. Each year's inventory revises earlier years.

indicators/indicators/forest-cover/sourc.zh-TW: 農業部林業及自然保育署

indicators/indicators/forest-cover/insig.zh-TW: 森林面積 219.7 萬公頃，其中 41.5 萬公頃長在法定林地以外。
indicators/indicators/forest-cover/insig.en: 2.197 million hectares of forest, of which 415,000 hectares grow outside designated forest land.

indicators/indicators/typhoons/title.zh-TW: 颱風平均每年侵台個數

indicators/indicators/typhoons/insight.zh-TW: 115 年間共 382 個颱風侵襲台灣，八月最多。
indicators/indicators/typhoons/insight.en: 382 typhoons struck Taiwan over 115 years, most often in August.

indicators/indicators/species/insight.zh-TW: 其中特有種 9,881 種，約占一成五；這是名錄資料庫的即時計數，含外來種，會隨更新變動。
indicators/indicators/species/insight.en: 9,881 of them, about 15%, are endemic. This is a live count from the catalogue database, including introduced species, and changes as it is updated.

indicators/indicators/land-area/insight.zh-TW: 包含台灣本島、澎湖、金門、馬祖與東沙等離島。
indicators/indicators/land-area/insight.en: Includes the main island of Taiwan plus Penghu, Kinmen, Matsu, Dongsha and other outlying islands.

indicators/indicators/yushan/insight.zh-TW: 東亞第一高峰；一座三萬多平方公里的島，從海平面到將近四千公尺。
indicators/indicators/yushan/insight.en: The highest peak in East Asia: an island of some 36,000 km² that climbs from sea level to almost 4,000 metres.

indicators/indicators/rainfall/insight.zh-TW: 是世界平均的 2.5 倍；但雨集中在梅雨與颱風季、河短流急，水留不太住。
indicators/indicators/rainfall/insight.en: Two and a half times the world average, but it falls mostly in the plum-rain and typhoon seasons on short, steep rivers, so little of it stays.

indicators/indicators/presidential-turno.zh-TW: 選舉人 1,955 萬人，投票 1,405 萬人。
indicators/indicators/presidential-turno.en: 19.55 million eligible voters, 14.05 million of whom voted.

indicators/indicators/legislature-seats/.zh-TW: 區域 73 席、不分區 34 席、原住民 6 席；不分區依政黨票比例分配。
indicators/indicators/legislature-seats/.en: 73 constituency seats, 34 party-list seats and 6 Indigenous seats; party-list seats are shared out by party vote.

indicators/indicators/freedom-house/insi.zh-TW: 列為「自由」；政治權利 38／40、公民自由 55／60。
indicators/indicators/freedom-house/insi.en: Rated Free: political rights 38/40, civil liberties 55/60.

indicators/indicators/press-freedom/insi.zh-TW: 分數從 77.04 降到 75.44，名次掉了四名。
indicators/indicators/press-freedom/insi.en: The score fell from 77.04 to 75.44, a drop of four places.

indicators/indicators/martial-law/insigh.zh-TW: 1949 年 5 月 19 日宣告、20 日起實施，到 1987 年 7 月 15 日解嚴；九年後台灣第一次直選總統。
indicators/indicators/martial-law/insigh.en: Declared on 19 May 1949 and in force from the 20th until it was lifted on 15 July 1987; nine years later Taiwan held its first direct presidential election.

indicators/indicators/monuments/source/a.zh-TW: 文化部（資料來源：文化資產局）
indicators/indicators/monuments/source/a.en: Ministry of Culture (Bureau of Cultural Heritage)

indicators/indicators/monuments/insight.zh-TW: 另有歷史建築 1,786 處、文化景觀 79 處、考古遺址 58 處，數的是已在文資系統登錄的件數。
indicators/indicators/monuments/insight.en: Plus 1,786 historic buildings, 79 cultural landscapes and 58 archaeological sites, counting entries registered in the heritage database.

indicators/indicators/museums/insight.en: A high of 348 in 2022 and 2023, then five fewer in 2024.

indicators/indicators/isbn-titles/source.zh-TW: 文化部統計處（原始資料：國家圖書館 ISBN 中心）
indicators/indicators/isbn-titles/source.en: Ministry of Culture (from the National Central Library ISBN Center)

indicators/indicators/isbn-titles/insigh.zh-TW: 2020 年到 2021 年從 3.5 萬種跳到 5.8 萬種，疑似統計口徑改變，跨這兩年比較要小心。
indicators/indicators/isbn-titles/insigh.en: The count jumped from 35,000 to 58,000 between 2020 and 2021, apparently a change in how it is counted, so compare across those years with care.

indicators/indicators/temples/period.zh-TW: 2015 年底（最新一次全國統計）

indicators/indicators/temples/insight.zh-TW: 道教占 78.5%、佛教 19.3%；另有教會（堂）3,280 座。這是內政部能找到的最新年度，現況請以全國宗教資訊網為準。
indicators/indicators/temples/insight.en: 78.5% Taoist and 19.3% Buddhist, alongside 3,280 churches. This is the latest year the ministry has published; check its religion portal for current figures.

indicators/indicators/domestic-film-shar.en: Taiwanese films' share of cinema admissions

indicators/indicators/domestic-film-shar.zh-TW: 2020、2021 年衝到兩成以上，是疫情讓好萊塢片停映的那兩年；2024 年全國觀影 2,335 萬人次。
indicators/indicators/domestic-film-shar.en: It jumped above 20% in 2020 and 2021, the years the pandemic halted Hollywood releases; total admissions in 2024 were 23.4 million.

indicators/indicators/rice-per-capita/ti.en: Rice eaten per person per year

indicators/indicators/rice-per-capita/in.zh-TW: 二十年少了 6.2 公斤，2023 年的 42.1 公斤是歷史新低；農業部把外送讓自己煮飯變少列為原因之一。
indicators/indicators/rice-per-capita/in.en: 6.2 kg less than twenty years ago; 2023's 42.1 kg was the lowest on record. The ministry cites food delivery, which means less home cooking, as one reason.

indicators/indicators/meat-per-capita/ti.en: Meat supply per person per year

indicators/indicators/meat-per-capita/in.zh-TW: 跟穀類（87.6 公斤）幾乎一樣多，是白米的兩倍；蔬菜 108.8、水果 104.3 公斤最多。
indicators/indicators/meat-per-capita/in.en: Almost the same as cereals (87.6 kg) and twice the rice; vegetables (108.8 kg) and fruit (104.3 kg) top the list.

indicators/indicators/food-self-sufficie.zh-TW: 1992 年跌破四成後，近二十年都在三成上下；吃進去的熱量，七成來自進口。
indicators/indicators/food-self-sufficie.en: Below 40% since 1992 and around 30% for two decades: seven in ten calories eaten come from imports.

indicators/indicators/thsr-ridership/sou.zh-TW: 台灣高速鐵路公司（114 年年報）
indicators/indicators/thsr-ridership/sou.en: Taiwan High Speed Rail Corporation (2025 annual report)

indicators/indicators/thsr-ridership/ins.zh-TW: 平均每天約 22.5 萬人次，座位利用率 71.59%。
indicators/indicators/thsr-ridership/ins.en: About 225,000 trips a day, with 71.59% of seats filled.

indicators/indicators/taipei-metro-daily.zh-TW: 臺北市政府主計處（依交通局統計）
全年 7.7 億人次，比前一年多 3.7%；台北車站一站每天進出 30 萬人次。
indicators/indicators/taipei-metro-daily.en: 770 million trips a year, up 3.7%; Taipei Main Station alone sees 300,000 entries and exits a day.

indicators/indicators/inbound-visitors/s.zh-TW: 交通部觀光署（資料來源：內政部移民署）

indicators/indicators/inbound-visitors/i.zh-TW: 日本旅客 148 萬人次最多；同年國人出國 1,894 萬人次，是來台人數的 2.2 倍。
indicators/indicators/inbound-visitors/i.en: Japan sent the most visitors, 1.48 million; the same year residents made 18.94 million trips abroad, 2.2 times as many.

indicators/indicators/olympic-medals/per.zh-TW: 2024 年夏季奧運（以「中華台北」名義參賽）

indicators/indicators/olympic-medals/ins.zh-TW: 金牌是李洋、王齊麟的羽球男雙，以及林郁婷的拳擊女子 57 公斤級。
indicators/indicators/olympic-medals/ins.en: The golds came from Lee Yang and Wang Chi-lin in men's doubles badminton and Lin Yu-ting in women's 57 kg boxing.

threads/threads/fertility/question.zh-TW: 出生的孩子少了一半，會先撞到誰？
threads/threads/fertility/question.en: Births have halved. Who feels it first?

threads/threads/fertility/answer.zh-TW:
2025 年台灣出生 107,812 人，是十年前的一半，總生育率 0.695。這一群孩子還沒長大，上一波下滑已經走到大學門口：來自高中的大學生源十年從 30.2 萬人降到 19.2 萬人，大專校院五年少了 13 所。

另一頭是變老的速度。65 歲以上的人口在 2025 年底跨過兩成，出生少於死亡已經連續六年。產業與家庭看護的人手有一部分由移工撐著，產業及社福移工十年從 58.8 萬人增加到 86.6 萬人。
threads/threads/fertility/answer.en:
Taiwan registered 107,812 births in 2025, half as many as ten years earlier, for a fertility rate of 0.695. Those children have yet to grow up, but an earlier decline has already reached the university gates: the pool of high-school seniors feeding university entry fell from 302,000 to 192,000 in ten years, and the number of tertiary institutions fell by 13 in five years.

At the other end is the speed of ageing. People aged 65 and over passed a fifth of the population at the end of 2025, and deaths have exceeded births for six years running. Part of the workforce in industry and home care is now migrant labour, which grew from 588,000 to 866,000 in a decade.

threads/threads/chips/question.zh-TW: 一座島怎麼供得起全世界的晶片？
threads/threads/chips/question.en: How does one island supply the world's chips?

threads/threads/chips/answer.zh-TW:
2025 年台灣的資通與視聽產品出口 2,511.5 億美元，一年增加將近九成。台積電一家占上市公司總市值四成一；TrendForce 估計，全球前十大晶圓代工的營收有七成以上是它的。

晶片要電也要水。十年之間，發電從燃煤為主轉成燃氣為主（47.7%），再生能源從 4.8% 升到 13.3%，核能在 2025 年只剩 1.1%。台灣年雨量約 2,500 毫米，是世界平均的 2.5 倍，但雨集中在梅雨與颱風季，河短流急，留得住的水有限，科學園區的用水跟電網一樣，是這個產業每年都要面對的條件。
threads/threads/chips/answer.en:
In 2025 Taiwan exported US$251.2 billion of ICT and audio-visual products, almost double the year before. TSMC alone accounts for 41% of the stock exchange's market value, and TrendForce estimates it takes over 70% of the revenue of the world's ten largest foundries.

Chips need power and water. In ten years generation shifted from mostly coal to mostly gas (47.7%), renewables rose from 4.8% to 13.3%, and nuclear fell to 1.1% in 2025. Taiwan gets about 2,500 mm of rain a year, two and a half times the world average, but it comes in the plum-rain and typhoon seasons and runs off short, steep rivers, so water for the science parks is, like the grid, a constraint the industry faces every year.

threads/threads/earning/question.zh-TW: 2025 年經濟長了 8.76%，這些錢從哪裡來，又落在哪裡？
threads/threads/earning/question.en: The economy grew 8.76% in 2025. Where did the money come from, and where did it land?

threads/threads/earning/answer.zh-TW:
8.76% 是 2013 年以來最高的成長率。出口 6,407.5 億美元，資通與電子產品占七成四；美國超過中國大陸與香港成為最大的出口市場，財政部說這是 26 年來第一次。

平均每人 GDP 來到 39,515 美元，這是總產出除以人口。同一張帳上，受僱者全年總薪資的中位數是 54.6 萬元（2024 年），最高兩成與最低兩成家庭的可支配所得差了 6.17 倍。三個數字放在一起，才看得出成長落在哪裡。
threads/threads/earning/answer.en:
8.76% was the fastest growth since at least 2013. Exports reached US$640.8 billion, 74% of them ICT and electronics, and the US overtook China and Hong Kong as the largest market, which the Ministry of Finance says is the first time in 26 years.

GDP per capita rose to US$39,515, which is total output divided by population. On the same ledger, the median employee earned NT$546,000 for the year (2024), and the richest fifth of households had 6.17 times the disposable income of the poorest fifth. It takes all three numbers together to see where the growth landed.

threads/threads/bowl/question.zh-TW: 台灣人吃進去的東西，有多少是台灣自己種的？
threads/threads/bowl/question.en: How much of what Taiwan eats does Taiwan grow?

threads/threads/bowl/answer.zh-TW:
以熱量計算，台灣的糧食自給率是 30.7%，吃進去的熱量七成靠進口；這個比例在 1992 年跌破四成，近二十年都在三成上下。

餐桌也在變。2024 年每人每年吃 42.4 公斤白米，比二十年前少 6.2 公斤；肉類 86.8 公斤，已經跟穀類差不多多。農業部把外送普及、自己煮飯變少，列為米吃得少的原因之一。
threads/threads/bowl/answer.en:
Measured in calories, Taiwan's food self-sufficiency is 30.7%: seven in ten calories eaten are imported. The share fell below 40% in 1992 and has hovered around 30% for two decades.

The table is changing too. In 2024 each person ate 42.4 kg of rice, 6.2 kg less than twenty years earlier, and 86.8 kg of meat, about as much as all cereals. The Ministry of Agriculture cites food delivery and less home cooking as one reason rice consumption is falling.

threads/threads/democracy/question.zh-TW: 戒嚴結束三十多年後，台灣的民主用數字看長什麼樣子？
threads/threads/democracy/question.en: More than thirty years after martial law, what does Taiwan's democracy look like in numbers?

threads/threads/democracy/answer.zh-TW:
台灣從 1949 年到 1987 年戒嚴了 38 年，解嚴九年後的 1996 年第一次直選總統。2024 年的總統選舉，1,955 萬名選舉人裡有 71.86% 去投票。

國際評比也有台灣這一列：Freedom House 2026 年給 93 分（滿分 100），列為「自由」；無國界記者的新聞自由指數 2026 年排第 28 名，比前一年退了四名。評比用的是外部機構自己的方法，這些權利是怎麼一步一步爭取來的，寫在下面的文章裡。
threads/threads/democracy/answer.en:
Taiwan lived under martial law for 38 years, from 1949 to 1987, and nine years after it ended, in 1996, held its first direct presidential election. In the 2024 presidential election, 71.86% of 19.55 million eligible voters turned out.

International rankings include Taiwan too: Freedom House scored it 93 out of 100 in 2026, rated Free, and Reporters Without Borders placed it 28th on the 2026 press freedom index, four places lower than the year before. The rankings use their publishers' own methods; how these rights were won, step by step, is in the articles below.

threads/threads/island/question.zh-TW: 三萬六千平方公里的島，裝得下多少地形與生命？
threads/threads/island/question.en: How much terrain and life fits on an island of 36,000 km²?

threads/threads/island/answer.zh-TW:
台灣有效管轄的土地約 36,197 平方公里，從海平面一路升到玉山主峰的 3,952 公尺。森林覆蓋六成，已記錄的物種有 66,470 種，其中 9,881 種只在台灣找得到。

同一副地形也帶來災害：1911 年以來，平均每年有 3 到 4 個颱風侵襲台灣，年雨量約 2,500 毫米，是世界平均的 2.5 倍。
threads/threads/island/answer.en:
Taiwan's territory covers about 36,197 km² and rises from sea level to 3,952 metres at the summit of Yushan. Forest covers 60% of it, and 66,470 species have been recorded, 9,881 of them found nowhere else.

The same terrain brings hazards: since 1911 an average of three to four typhoons a year have struck Taiwan, and annual rainfall of about 2,500 mm is two and a half times the world average.

threads/threads/moving/question.zh-TW: 台灣人每天怎麼移動，又怎麼付錢？
threads/threads/moving/question.en: How do people in Taiwan get around, and how do they pay?

threads/threads/moving/answer.zh-TW:
高鐵 2025 年載了 8,207 萬人次，平均每天 22.5 萬；臺北捷運每天 210 萬人次，光是台北車站就有 30 萬人進出。

付錢的方式也在換。會上網的人裡，51% 最近三個月用過行動支付，2020 年還只有 32.8%。往外看，2025 年來台旅客 857 萬人次，國人出國 1,894 萬人次。
threads/threads/moving/answer.en:
High-speed rail carried 82.07 million passengers in 2025, about 225,000 a day, while the Taipei Metro carries 2.1 million trips a day, 300,000 of them through Taipei Main Station alone.

Payment is changing as well: 51% of internet users had used mobile payment in the past three months, up from 32.8% in 2020. Looking outward, Taiwan received 8.57 million visitors in 2025 while residents made 18.94 million trips abroad.

sources/groups/official/intro.zh-TW: 政府資料開放平臺是目錄，真正的統計多半住在各部會自己的網站。查一個數字，先找負責發布它的那個機關。
sources/groups/official/intro.en: The national open-data portal is a catalogue; most statistics actually live on each ministry's own site. To look up a number, start with the agency that publishes it.

sources/groups/official/items/0/good.zh-TW: 全國資料集的總目錄，52,556 個資料集（2026-10-23），整份清單可以下載成 CSV。
sources/groups/official/items/0/good.en: The national catalogue: 52,556 datasets as of 23 Oct 2026, and the whole list can be downloaded as CSV.

sources/groups/official/items/0/tip.zh-TW: 很多資料集是同一張表一年一份，把標題裡的民國年去掉後只剩約 4.35 萬個不同標題；要時間序列得自己拼。
sources/groups/official/items/0/tip.en: Many datasets are the same table split by year; strip the ROC year from titles and only about 43,500 distinct ones remain, so you assemble the time series yourself.

sources/groups/official/items/1/good.zh-TW: 經濟成長率、物價、失業率、薪資等重要指標的第一手發布，當天新聞稿與發布時程都在這裡。
sources/groups/official/items/1/good.en: First release of headline indicators such as GDP growth, prices, unemployment and wages, with same-day press releases and the release calendar.

sources/groups/official/items/1/tip.zh-TW: 伺服器沒送中繼憑證，用程式抓（Python、curl、Node）會連線失敗，瀏覽器正常。
sources/groups/official/items/1/tip.en: The server omits its intermediate certificate, so scripted downloads (Python, curl, Node) fail while browsers work.

sources/groups/official/items/2/name.zh-TW: 縣市重要統計指標查詢系統

sources/groups/official/items/2/good.zh-TW: 22 縣市同一口徑的土地、人口、婚育、年齡結構等指標，適合做縣市比較。
sources/groups/official/items/2/good.en: Land, population, marriage, births and age structure for all 22 counties and cities on one basis, ideal for comparisons.

sources/groups/official/items/3/good.zh-TW: 薪資中位數與分布的互動查詢，是政府做給大眾看的儀表板裡做得最好的之一。
sources/groups/official/items/3/good.en: Interactive wage medians and distributions; one of the best public-facing government dashboards.

sources/groups/official/items/4/name.zh-TW: 三大普查統計資料平臺

sources/groups/official/items/4/good.zh-TW: 人口及住宅、農林漁牧業、工業及服務業普查；唯一細到統計區的來源。
sources/groups/official/items/4/good.en: Population and housing, agriculture, and industry censuses; the only source down to statistical-area level.

sources/groups/official/items/5/good.zh-TW: 每月的人口、出生、死亡、結婚、離婚，細到村里，同婚統計也在這裡。
sources/groups/official/items/5/good.en: Monthly population, births, deaths, marriages and divorces down to village level, including same-sex marriage figures.

sources/groups/official/items/6/name.zh-TW: 社會經濟資料服務平台

sources/groups/official/items/6/good.zh-TW: 把統計數字綁到最小統計區的圖資，做地圖分析的起點。
sources/groups/official/items/6/good.en: Statistics attached to the smallest statistical areas, the starting point for map analysis.

sources/groups/official/items/7/good.zh-TW: 按國家、按貨品的進出口，每月發布。
sources/groups/official/items/7/good.en: Imports and exports by country and product, released monthly.

sources/groups/official/items/8/org.en: Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan)

sources/groups/official/items/8/good.zh-TW: 利率、匯率、貨幣與外匯存底的權威時間序列。
sources/groups/official/items/8/good.en: The authoritative series for interest rates, exchange rates, money supply and foreign reserves.

sources/groups/official/items/8/tip.zh-TW: 有些檔案仍是 Big5 編碼。

sources/groups/official/items/9/good.zh-TW: 發電結構、再生能源、能源供需的月資料，格式乾淨。
sources/groups/official/items/9/good.en: Clean monthly data on the power mix, renewables and energy supply.

sources/groups/official/items/10/good.zh-TW: 逐機組即時發電、系統供需、各鄉鎮用電，每 10 分鐘更新，不用金鑰。
sources/groups/official/items/10/good.en: Real-time output by generating unit, system supply and demand, and electricity use by township, updated every 10 minutes with no key.

sources/groups/official/items/11/good.zh-TW: 空品、水質、廢棄物、環評；API 文件是政府平台裡寫得最清楚的一個。
sources/groups/official/items/11/good.en: Air and water quality, waste and impact assessments; its API documentation is the clearest among government platforms.

sources/groups/official/items/11/tip.zh-TW: 不註冊每支 API 一天 300 次，註冊後 5,000 次。
sources/groups/official/items/11/tip.en: 300 calls a day per API without an account, 5,000 with one.

sources/groups/official/items/12/name.zh-TW: TDX 運輸資料流通服務

sources/groups/official/items/12/good.zh-TW: 公車、鐵路、航空、自行車、停車的即時資料；欄位一致、有多語，是開發者生態最成熟的一個。
sources/groups/official/items/12/good.en: Real-time buses, rail, flights, bikes and parking; consistent fields, multilingual, and the most mature developer ecosystem.

sources/groups/official/items/13/good.zh-TW: 預報、觀測、地震、海象；全國下載次數最多的兩個資料集都是它的地震報告。
sources/groups/official/items/13/good.en: Forecasts, observations, earthquakes and sea conditions; the two most downloaded datasets in the country are its earthquake reports.

sources/groups/official/items/14/good.zh-TW: 歷屆總統、立委、地方選舉、公投與罷免的投開票結果，投票後 7 日內更新。
sources/groups/official/items/14/good.en: Results of every presidential, legislative and local election, referendum and recall, updated within 7 days of voting.

sources/groups/official/items/15/name.zh-TW: 立法院開放資料服務平台

sources/groups/official/items/15/good.zh-TW: 議案、表決、質詢、委員發言，幾乎每天更新，不用金鑰。
sources/groups/official/items/15/good.en: Bills, votes, interpellations and speeches, updated almost daily with no key.

sources/groups/official/items/16/name.zh-TW: 證交所與櫃買中心 OpenAPI

sources/groups/official/items/16/org.zh-TW: 臺灣證券交易所、證券櫃檯買賣中心

sources/groups/official/items/16/good.zh-TW: 個股收盤、成交與上市櫃公司基本資料，兩邊合計三百多個端點，不用金鑰。
sources/groups/official/items/16/good.en: Daily prices, trading and company profiles for listed firms, over 300 endpoints combined, no key needed.

sources/groups/official/items/16/tip.zh-TW: 同一筆回應裡，日期欄用民國（1151022），成立日期卻是西元（19501229）；數值全部是字串。
sources/groups/official/items/16/tip.en: Within a single response the date field is in ROC years (1151022) while the founding date is Gregorian (19501229), and every number is a string.

sources/groups/official/items/17/good.zh-TW: 農產品行情、漁業、畜牧，有 1,718 個資料集；糧食供需統計另在農業部統計處。
sources/groups/official/items/17/good.en: Produce prices, fisheries and livestock across 1,718 datasets; food supply statistics are published separately by its statistics office.

sources/groups/official/items/18/good.zh-TW: 博物館、圖書館、出版、電影、文化資產的年度數據。
sources/groups/official/items/18/good.en: Annual figures for museums, libraries, publishing, film and cultural heritage.

sources/groups/local/items/0/good.zh-TW: 24 個主題分類，可以線上預覽、下載與 API 介接。
sources/groups/local/items/0/good.en: 24 topic categories with online preview, downloads and API access.

sources/groups/local/items/1/good.zh-TW: 捷運進出、YouBike、施工、社宅進度的即時儀表板，程式碼開源，是全國少見的市政儀表板。
sources/groups/local/items/1/good.en: Live dashboard of metro flows, YouBike, roadworks and social housing; open source and a rare example of a city dashboard.

sources/groups/local/items/2/good.zh-TW: 目錄筆數最多的直轄市之一。
sources/groups/local/items/2/good.en: One of the largest municipal catalogues.

sources/groups/local/items/2/tip.zh-TW: API 端點要帶授權才回資料。

sources/groups/local/items/3/name.zh-TW: 臺南市與高雄市資料開放平台

sources/groups/local/items/3/org.zh-TW: 臺南市政府、高雄市政府

sources/groups/local/items/3/good.zh-TW: 兩市都提供整份資料清冊下載，最容易用程式串接。
sources/groups/local/items/3/good.en: Both publish a downloadable inventory of every dataset, the easiest to integrate programmatically.

sources/groups/civic/title.zh-TW: 公民科技與民間資料庫

sources/groups/civic/intro.zh-TW: 民間接住了政府沒做的事：把資料整理成 API、替只給即時值的資料留下歷史、把預算審議拆成一筆一筆。
sources/groups/civic/intro.en: Civil society picks up what government leaves undone: turning data into APIs, keeping history for feeds that only show the present, and breaking budget reviews into individual line items.

sources/groups/civic/items/0/good.zh-TW: 3,445 份以上整理好的公共資料集，多數附 AI 說明書，CC BY 4.0，也有給 AI 代理人讀的 llms.txt。
sources/groups/civic/items/0/good.en: Over 3,445 cleaned public datasets, most with an AI-readable guide, under CC BY 4.0, plus an llms.txt for AI agents.

sources/groups/civic/items/0/tip.zh-TW: 查詢要 Token；2026 年全站免費試用，之後的價格未公布。
sources/groups/civic/items/0/tip.en: Queries need a token; free trial for all of 2026, with later pricing not yet published.

sources/groups/civic/items/1/good.zh-TW: 議案、立委、公報、會議與影片的結構化 API，持續更新。
sources/groups/civic/items/1/good.en: A structured API for bills, legislators, gazettes, meetings and video, actively maintained.

sources/groups/civic/items/2/name.zh-TW: 中央政府總預算案審查監督平台

sources/groups/civic/items/2/good.zh-TW: 每一筆預算刪減與凍結的提案人與理由，看得到審議細節；程式碼與資料都開源。本站的總預算十年看長期趨勢，兩者互補。
sources/groups/civic/items/2/good.en: Who proposed each budget cut or freeze and why, down to the line item; code and data are open. Taiwan.md's Budget Decade covers the long-term trend, so the two complement each other.

sources/groups/civic/items/3/name.zh-TW: Cofacts 真的假的開放資料

sources/groups/civic/items/3/good.zh-TW: 群眾查核 LINE 訊息累積的資料集，放在 Hugging Face，CC BY-SA 4.0。
sources/groups/civic/items/3/good.en: A dataset built from crowd-sourced fact-checks of LINE messages, hosted on Hugging Face under CC BY-SA 4.0.

sources/groups/civic/items/4/name.zh-TW: 開放台灣民間租屋資料

sources/groups/civic/items/4/good.zh-TW: 2018 年起長期整理租屋網的公開資訊，聚合成月、季、年資料。
sources/groups/civic/items/4/good.en: Public listing data from rental sites, collected since 2018 and aggregated by month, quarter and year.

sources/groups/civic/items/5/good.zh-TW: 台電網站只給即時值，這個 repo 把它每天存進 git，留下了官方沒保存的歷史。
sources/groups/civic/items/5/good.en: Taipower's site only shows the present; this repository commits it to git every day, keeping history the official site does not.

sources/groups/civic/items/5/tip.zh-TW: 欄位說明與授權需要自己確認。
sources/groups/civic/items/5/tip.en: Check field definitions and licensing yourself.

sources/groups/civic/items/6/good.zh-TW: 黑客松與公民科技活動，想找人一起做資料專案的入口。
sources/groups/civic/items/6/good.en: Hackathons and civic-tech events; the place to find collaborators for a data project.

sources/groups/media/intro.zh-TW: 這些團隊把資料做成報導。多數報導沒有附上底層資料，引用數字時回到它們標明的官方來源。
sources/groups/media/intro.en: These teams turn data into reporting. Most stories do not publish their underlying data, so cite the official source they name.

sources/groups/media/items/0/good.zh-TW: 固定編制設計、工程、資料整理；事故地圖、政治獻金等深度資料報導。
sources/groups/media/items/0/good.en: Dedicated design, engineering and data staff; in-depth data stories on traffic accidents, political donations and more.

sources/groups/media/items/1/good.zh-TW: 少數明確承諾公開報導資料的團隊，GitHub 上有資料與程式。
sources/groups/media/items/1/good.en: One of the few teams that explicitly commits to publishing its data, with data and code on GitHub.

sources/groups/media/items/2/good.zh-TW: 幾乎每天一張的新聞圖表，預算、經濟、選舉都有。
sources/groups/media/items/2/good.en: News graphics almost daily, covering the budget, the economy and elections.

sources/groups/media/items/3/good.zh-TW: 數位敘事專題，資料來源寫在專題裡。
sources/groups/media/items/3/good.en: Digital storytelling projects with sources noted in each piece.

sources/groups/media/items/4/good.zh-TW: 珍奶、百岳、街頭小吃、高齡化等主題的捲動式資料敘事，會把資料限制寫出來。
sources/groups/media/items/4/good.en: Scrollytelling data stories on bubble tea, Taiwan's 100 peaks, street food and ageing, with data limitations spelled out.

sources/groups/academic/items/0/org.zh-TW: 中央研究院 GIS 中心

sources/groups/academic/items/0/good.zh-TW: 百年來的歷史地圖，用 WMTS 標準服務，QGIS 等軟體可以直接疊圖。
sources/groups/academic/items/0/good.en: A century of historical maps served via the WMTS standard, ready to overlay in QGIS and similar tools.

sources/groups/academic/items/0/tip.zh-TW: 服務頁沒寫授權，引用前要自己確認。
sources/groups/academic/items/0/tip.en: The service page states no licence, so confirm before reuse.

sources/groups/academic/items/1/good.zh-TW: 學界與政府的調查原始資料，附問卷與編碼簿；台灣選舉與民主化調查、社會變遷調查都由這裡釋出。
sources/groups/academic/items/1/good.en: Raw survey data from academia and government, with questionnaires and codebooks; Taiwan's election and social change surveys are released here.

sources/groups/academic/items/2/name.zh-TW: 重要政治態度分佈趨勢圖

sources/groups/academic/items/2/org.zh-TW: 政治大學選舉研究中心
sources/groups/academic/items/2/org.en: Election Study Center, National Chengchi University

sources/groups/academic/items/2/good.zh-TW: 台灣人／中國人認同、統獨立場、政黨偏好，1992 年起的長期序列。
sources/groups/academic/items/2/good.en: Long-run series since 1992 on Taiwanese/Chinese identity, independence/unification views and party preference.

sources/groups/academic/items/2/tip.zh-TW: 民調的問法不同，結果就不同；引用時一併說明是哪一份調查。
sources/groups/academic/items/2/tip.en: Different question wording yields different results; always say which survey a figure comes from.

sources/groups/academic/items/3/org.zh-TW: 文化部、國立臺灣歷史博物館
sources/groups/academic/items/3/org.en: Ministry of Culture, National Museum of Taiwan History

sources/groups/academic/items/3/good.zh-TW: 標示 CC 授權或公眾領域的典藏可以直接下載。
sources/groups/academic/items/3/good.en: Items marked with a CC licence or public domain can be downloaded directly.

sources/groups/academic/items/3/tip.zh-TW: Open API 要申請金鑰並提供固定 IP。
sources/groups/academic/items/3/tip.en: The open API requires an application, a key and a fixed IP address.

sources/groups/academic/items/4/org.zh-TW: 中央研究院數位文化中心
sources/groups/academic/items/4/org.en: Academia Sinica Center for Digital Cultures

sources/groups/academic/items/4/good.zh-TW: 百萬件以上藏品，註冊後可以用來策展。
sources/groups/academic/items/4/good.en: Over a million collection items that registered users can curate into exhibitions.

sources/groups/international/title.zh-TW: 國際上有台灣這一列的資料庫

sources/groups/international/intro.zh-TW: 做國際比較時，先確認資料庫裡有沒有台灣這一列。下面這些有；名稱怎麼寫，見上方「國際資料庫」那一節。
sources/groups/international/intro.en: Before comparing internationally, check that a database has a Taiwan row at all. These do; for how each one names Taiwan, see the international databases section above.

sources/groups/international/items/0/goo.zh-TW: GDP、成長率與預測，可以跟其他經濟體用同一套方法比較。
sources/groups/international/items/0/goo.en: GDP, growth and forecasts, comparable with other economies on one method.

sources/groups/international/items/1/goo.zh-TW: 購買力平價的長期總體序列。
sources/groups/international/items/1/goo.en: Long-run macro series at purchasing-power parity.

sources/groups/international/items/2/goo.zh-TW: 跨國比較的圖表與 CSV，用 country=~TWN 就能只抓台灣。
sources/groups/international/items/2/goo.en: Cross-country charts and CSVs; add country=~TWN to pull Taiwan alone.

sources/groups/international/items/3/org.zh-TW: 哥德堡大學 V-Dem 研究所

sources/groups/international/items/3/goo.zh-TW: 民主程度的專家編碼指標，1900 年起。

sources/groups/international/items/4/goo.zh-TW: 網路使用率等電信指標的國際比較。
sources/groups/international/items/4/goo.en: International comparisons of telecom indicators such as internet use.

sources/groups/international/items/5/nam.zh-TW: CSIS ChinaPower 防空識別區資料

sources/groups/international/items/5/org.zh-TW: 美國戰略與國際研究中心
sources/groups/international/items/5/org.en: Center for Strategic and International Studies

sources/groups/international/items/5/goo.zh-TW: 中國軍機進入台灣防空識別區的每日紀錄，署名編者。
sources/groups/international/items/5/goo.en: Daily records of Chinese military aircraft entering Taiwan's air defence identification zone, with named compilers.

sources/groups/international/items/5/tip.zh-TW: 各來源對次數的口徑不同（進入 ADIZ 或周邊偵獲、飛機與艦艇是否合計），數字對不上很常見。
sources/groups/international/items/5/tip.en: Sources count differently (entering the ADIZ versus detected nearby, aircraft and ships combined or not), so their totals often disagree.

sources/groups/finance/intro.zh-TW: 民間做得最完整的台灣資料彙整幾乎都在財經領域，多為商業服務，使用前看清條款。
sources/groups/finance/intro.en: The most complete private compilations of Taiwanese data are almost all financial and mostly commercial, so read the terms first.

sources/groups/finance/items/0/good.zh-TW: 把上市櫃財報做成圖表與選股條件，多數功能免費。
sources/groups/finance/items/0/good.en: Charts and screening built from listed companies' filings; most features are free.

sources/groups/finance/items/2/good.zh-TW: 三十多年的證券與總經資料庫，學術研究常用。
sources/groups/finance/items/2/good.en: A securities and macro database with over 30 years of history, widely used in academic research.

sources/pitfalls/0/body.zh-TW: 三成左右的資料集標題帶民國年，欄位裡的「114」是西元 2025 年；同一支 API 也可能民國、西元混用。
sources/pitfalls/0/body.en: About three in ten dataset titles carry ROC years: "114" in a field means 2025. A single API can mix ROC and Gregorian dates.

sources/pitfalls/1/body.zh-TW: 約一成資料集仍是 Big5 編碼的 CSV，直接用 UTF-8 打開會是亂碼，先轉碼。
sources/pitfalls/1/body.en: About one dataset in ten is still a Big5-encoded CSV, which turns to gibberish if opened as UTF-8; convert it first.

sources/pitfalls/2/body.zh-TW: 1,187 個資料集只有 PDF，月報也常是 PDF；要用程式讀得先解析。
sources/pitfalls/2/body.en: 1,187 datasets exist only as PDFs, and monthly bulletins often are too, so they have to be parsed before use.

sources/pitfalls/3/body.zh-TW: 薪資平均數會被高薪拉高，中位數才是一半的人賺得比這少的那條線；人力銀行的薪資調查跟主計總處口徑不同，不能直接比。
sources/pitfalls/3/body.en: Average wages are pulled up by high earners; the median is the line half of workers fall below. Job-site salary surveys use a different basis from official statistics and cannot be compared directly.

sources/pitfalls/4/title.zh-TW: 同一個數字有好幾個版本

sources/pitfalls/4/body.zh-TW: 台灣人口在國際彙整站上能差到十幾萬人，因為各自用不同年份、不同推估。查台灣的數字，以發布它的台灣官方機關為準，並寫出期間。
sources/pitfalls/4/body.en: International aggregators disagree on Taiwan's population by over a hundred thousand because they use different years and estimates. Use the Taiwanese agency that publishes the figure, and state the period.

sources/pitfalls/5/body.zh-TW: 政府網站常只給即時值不留歷史，也會整批下架（疾管署 2026 年 8 月一次下架 234 個病例統計資料集）。用到的資料，記下取得日期與網址。
sources/pitfalls/5/body.en: Government sites often show only the present and can withdraw data in bulk (in August 2026 the CDC pulled 234 case-statistics datasets at once). Record the date and URL of anything you use.

sources/pitfalls/6/body.zh-TW: 政府資料開放授權條款允許商業使用、與 CC BY 4.0 相容，但沒有標示原提供機關，就視為自始沒有取得授權。
sources/pitfalls/6/body.en: Taiwan's open government data licence allows commercial use and is compatible with CC BY 4.0, but reuse without naming the original agency counts as never having been licensed.

sources/pitfalls/7/title.zh-TW: 國際資料庫可能沒有台灣

sources/pitfalls/7/body.zh-TW: 世界銀行、WHO、UNESCO、UNDP 都沒有台灣這一列。用它們做國際比較時，台灣那一格要改用台灣官方統計，並註明來源不同。
sources/pitfalls/7/body.en: The World Bank, WHO, UNESCO and UNDP have no Taiwan row. When comparing with them, fill Taiwan's cell from Taiwan's official statistics and note the different source.

intl/rows/0/note.zh-TW: 國家列表 296 筆沒有台灣；中國那一欄註明「不含 Taiwan, China」，世界銀行請讀者改看台灣政府網站
intl/rows/0/note.en: None of its 296 economies is Taiwan; the China series is footnoted as excluding "Taiwan, China", and the Bank refers readers to Taiwan's own government sites

intl/rows/1/note.zh-TW: 2025 年 HDI 時間序列 206 個經濟體，沒有台灣
intl/rows/1/note.en: The 2025 HDI time series covers 206 economies, without Taiwan

intl/rows/2/note.zh-TW: 234 個國家代碼裡沒有台灣，健康指標查不到台灣
intl/rows/2/note.en: No Taiwan among its 234 country codes, so no Taiwan health indicators

intl/rows/3/note.zh-TW: 教育統計的 462 個地理單位沒有台灣
intl/rows/3/note.en: None of its 462 geographic units for education statistics is Taiwan

intl/rows/4/note.zh-TW: 代碼 158 存在，名稱寫成「東亞其他未指明地區」，底下沒有任何資料
intl/rows/4/note.en: Code 158 exists under this name and holds no data

intl/rows/5/note.zh-TW: 有完整的 GDP、成長率與預測，名稱帶「Province of China」
intl/rows/5/note.en: Full GDP, growth and forecast series, labelled with "Province of China"

intl/rows/6/note.zh-TW: 人口推估有台灣這一列，名稱以「China」開頭
intl/rows/6/note.en: Taiwan has its own row in the projections, under a name that starts with "China"

intl/rows/7/note.zh-TW: 網路使用率等電信指標有台灣
intl/rows/7/note.en: Telecom indicators such as internet use include Taiwan

intl/rows/9/note.zh-TW: 長期人均 GDP 序列有台灣
intl/rows/9/note.en: Long-run GDP per capita series includes Taiwan

intl/rows/10/note.zh-TW: 國家代碼標準；TW／TWN／158 這組代碼本身是各資料庫串接台灣的鑰匙
intl/rows/10/note.en: The country-code standard; its TW / TWN / 158 codes are how other databases join Taiwan

intl/rows/11/note.zh-TW: 代碼表有這一列，實際勞動資料覆蓋多少尚未查證
intl/rows/11/note.en: Listed in the code table; actual labour data coverage not yet verified

intl/rows/12/note.zh-TW: 以「台澎金馬個別關稅領域」身分加入（2002）
intl/rows/12/note.en: A member since 2002 as the Separate Customs Territory of Taiwan, Penghu, Kinmen and Matsu

intl/rows/13/note.zh-TW: 台灣不是會員，科技指標等部分資料集有台灣；PISA 也用這個名稱
intl/rows/13/note.en: Not a member; some datasets such as science and technology indicators, and PISA, include Taiwan under this name

intl/rows/15/note.zh-TW: PPP 實質 GDP 等總體序列，到 2023 年
intl/rows/15/note.en: PPP real GDP and other macro series, to 2023

intl/rows/16/note.zh-TW: 名稱用 Taiwan；有沒有台灣看它用的上游資料，上游是世界銀行或 UNDP 的圖就沒有
intl/rows/16/note.en: Uses "Taiwan", but coverage follows its upstream source: charts built on World Bank or UNDP data have no Taiwan

intl/rows/17/note.zh-TW: 有台灣頁面，人口一格的來源是 Wikidata，不是官方統計
intl/rows/17/note.en: Has a Taiwan page, though its population figure comes from Wikidata, not an official statistics office

intl/rows/18/note.zh-TW: 民主指標，文件寫明中國條目不含台灣、港澳
intl/rows/18/note.en: Democracy indices; its documentation states the China unit excludes Taiwan, Hong Kong and Macau

intl/selfComputed/hdi/rank.zh-TW: 依 UNDP 公式編算，2023 年排名第 21
intl/selfComputed/hdi/rank.en: Computed with the UNDP formula; 21st for 2023

intl/selfComputed/gii/rank.zh-TW: 依 UNDP 公式編算，2023 年 173 國第 13
intl/selfComputed/gii/rank.en: Computed with the UNDP formula; 13th of 173 for 2023

intl/selfComputed/gii/by.en: Department of Gender Equality, Executive Yuan

intl/selfComputed/ggi/rank.zh-TW: 依 WEF 公式編算，2025 年 148 國第 35
intl/selfComputed/ggi/rank.en: Computed with the WEF formula; 35th of 148 for 2025

intl/selfComputed/ggi/by.en: Department of Gender Equality, Executive Yuan
